Commentary.Commentary: The match officials are out in the middle followed by the players of Ireland and the two openers for UAE. Muhammad Waseem and Aryansh Sharma are the two openers for UAE, while Joshua Little will bowl the first over.
...RUN CHASE...

Right then, UAE have an uphill task to climb here but have some hard-hitting batters in their ranks so they will want to go out there and play freely. They will need their devastating openers to get them off to a good start and take the game as deep as possible. The Irish bowling has received some stick through the competition and will want to show their quality by defending this total. The pressure will not be there on them with the score that has been posted on the board and will want to stick to the basic. Do join us shortly as we return for the run chase. In the meantime do check out the fixtures for the 2023 ICC Cricket World Cup which was announced earlier today.

The man of the moment, Paul Stirling is up for a chat! He says that it was really tough to start and the first few balls were good but the confidence grew with the innings. Adds that there are a few things they did well and doing the basics right was the most important of them. Mentions that the side would be happy with a win to end but will need to work really hard for it.

The Irish batters got off to a tentative start as they looked to negotiate the early swing on offer and soon began playing their shots. Sanchit Sharma came into the attack as the first change and drew first blood when he trapped Andy McBrine in front of the stumps on 24. It was one-way traffic thereafter as Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie added 184 runs in 178 deliveries for the second wicket. Ali Naseer got the much-needed breakthrough dismissing the skipper on 66. Paul Stirling went on a rampage reaching his 14th ODI century but was finally dismissed on 162 in 134 deliveries by Sanchit. Harry Tector provided the acceleration towards the end as he reached his half-century as well in quick time. Lorcan Tucker and George Dockrell provided the finishing touches as they fell just short of the 350-run mark. Sanchit Sharma was the pick of the bowlers by far as he claimed three wickets for 46 runs in his 7 overs.

This has been a dominating batting display by Ireland! They are looking to go out of the competition with a bang and they have posted a mammoth total of 349 runs courtesy of a well-constructed inning by their star batter Paul Stirling. The UAE bowlers were not up to the mark and they will be even more disappointed with their fielding effort as it was marred with dropped catches and misfields. Ireland will be silently confident of defending this target but will no that nothing can be taken for granted as we have already seen in the tournament.

The umpires and the two sets of players have made their way out onto the ground and will lineup for the national anthems. It will be the national anthem of the United Arab Emirates first followed by Ireland's national anthem.

Andy Balbirnie, the captain of Ireland says that they would have bowled first as well as it is a hard ground to defend and there are some footmarks too so it may turn a bit in the later half of the game. Adds that the team is hurting a lot and they want to feel good so the best way is to put up a convincing performance here. He mentions that they are sticking with th same side.

Muhammad Waseem the skipper of the United Arab Emirates says that they would like to field first as the pitch looks solid and the conditions will assist the seamers early on. Adds that they would like to restrict the opponents to a low total. Also adds that the tournament did not go as per plan for them but the team will continue with the same process. UAE have also had a horrific time in Zimbabwe as they failed to impress and have looked like the weakest side in the tournament by far. The Asian side came into the tournament with a lot of positive momentum and batters in form but they have let down the team when it mattered the most. The failure of skipper Muhammad Waseem and keeper Vriitya Aravind with the bat has halted the run flow as they have been heavily relied on. Bowlers tried their bit but failed to impose themselves on opponents. UAE would be eager to inflict an upset against a Test-playing nation and it is to be seen which side can sign off with a victory under their belt. Stay tuned for toss and team updates.

Ireland have had a horrible time here in Zimbabwe losing all three games played so far. The Irish side started the campaign with a shocker against Oman and never bounced back losing the following games as well. The woes of the top order have been haunting them for a while now and the out-of-form skipper is a big concern for the side. A lot was expected of the middle muddle that have delivered up to some extent but the bowlers have failed miserably as well. The Irish would be looking to sign off with a victory and take some confidence back home. The batters and the bowlers need to back each other in the final encounter.

The Group stages of the ICC World Cup Qualifiers 2023 are nearing their end as Ireland cross swords against United Arab Emirates at the Bulawayo Athletic Club. This is the last game for both of them with no chance of qualification for the Super Six. Expections were high on Ireland but they haven't played to their potential at all. They should have won the match against Scotland but were not up to the mark against Oman and Sri Lanka. Their skipper, Andy Balbirnie will hope that his boys show up in this game and at least get a consolation win. Their batting department relies on the likes of Paul Stirling, Lorcan Tucker, Harry Tector and the skipper himself while they have two decent all-rounders in Curtis Campher and George Dockrell. They also have a great pace duo in Mark Adair and Joshua Little but all of their players would be disappointed with their performance and would want to play for pride in this match. United Arab Emirates, on the other hand, have also lost their three games but this will only help them get the experience they could use in the future. Vriitya Aravind has been their best batter in the tournament as Rohan Mustafa and Muhammad Waseem haven't been able to get going which has hurt them a lot. Aayan Khan has also contributed decently in both departments while Basil Hameed looks in good touch. Their bowling, though, has been good with Zahoor Khan and Junaid Siddique being their frontline pacers who gives them early breakthroughs while Karthik Meiyappan has been their best spinner. However, they still need to improve a lot in this format to be able to compete against the likes of Ireland and other teams in this tournament. Let's find out together who ends their campaign with a victory.
